---
title: "Dynamic Report"
output: html_document
params:
  conceptId: NULL
  CDMdbHandler: NULL
  showsMappings: FALSE
  pruneLevels: NULL
  pruneClass: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

conceptId <- params$conceptId |> as.integer()
CDMdbHandler <- params$CDMdbHandler
showsMappings <- params$showsMappings
pruneLevels <- params$pruneLevels 
pruneClass <- params$pruneClass

# Set dynamic title based on conceptId parameter
if (!is.null(conceptId)) {
  title <- paste("Concept ID:", conceptId, "showsMappings:", showsMappings, "pruneLevels:", pruneLevels)
} else {
  title <- "Dynamic Report"
}

```

# `r title`
  
```{r}
relationships <- getConceptRelationships_memoise(
  CDMdbHandler,
  conceptId = conceptId
)
results <- list(
  concept_relationships = relationships$concept_relationships,
  concepts = relationships$concepts,
  stratified_code_counts = getCodeCountsStratified_memoise(
    CDMdbHandler,
    conceptId = conceptId
  )
)

if (pruneLevels != 0L | pruneClass != '') {
  results <- pruneLevelsFromResults(results, pruneLevels, pruneClass = pruneClass)
}
```


Graph
```{r}
mermaid <- createMermaidGraphFromResults(results, showsMappings = showsMappings)
DiagrammeR::mermaid(mermaid, width = "100%", height = "100%")
```

Table
```{r}
createCodeCountsTableFromResults(results)
``` 

Plot
```{r}
createPlotFromResults(results, showsMappings = showsMappings, width = 1000, height = 1000)
```

## Person Counts

```{r}
personCounts <- list(
  filter_person_counts = getPersonCountsFilters_memoise(CDMdbHandler, conceptIds = paste0(conceptId, "SD")),
  upset_person_counts = getPersonCountsUpset_memoise(CDMdbHandler, conceptIds = paste0(conceptId, "SD")),
  prevalence_person_counts = getPersonCountsPrevalence_memoise(CDMdbHandler, conceptIds = paste0(conceptId, "SD")),
  incidence_person_counts = getPersonCountsIncidence_memoise(CDMdbHandler, conceptIds = paste0(conceptId, "SD"))
)
visitTypeNames <- getVisitTypeNames_memoise(CDMdbHandler)
```

Sex
```{r}
createSexPieChartFromPersonCounts(personCounts$filter_person_counts)
```

Age
```{r}
createAgeHistogramFromPersonCounts(personCounts$filter_person_counts)
```

Visit type
```{r}
createVisitBarplotFromPersonCounts(personCounts$filter_person_counts, visitTypeNames)
```

Set overlap (UpSet)
```{r}
createUpsetPlotFromPersonCounts(personCounts$upset_person_counts, results$concepts)
```

Prevalence
```{r}
createPrevalencePlotFromPersonCounts(personCounts$prevalence_person_counts, results$concepts)
```

Incidence
```{r}
createIncidencePlotFromPersonCounts(personCounts$incidence_person_counts, results$concepts)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Measured values only exist for the Measurement domain, and
# getMeasurementValueHistogram() deliberately errors on anything else -- so decide
# up front whether this section runs at all rather than calling it and catching.
isMeasurement <- results$concepts |>
  dplyr::filter(concept_id == conceptId) |>
  dplyr::pull(domain_id) |>
  (\(x) length(x) > 0 && all(x == "Measurement"))()

measurementHistogram <- NULL
if (isMeasurement) {
  # same "SD" token the person-counts section uses: a LOINC Group carries no events of
  # its own, so the descendants are where the values actually are
  measurementHistogram <- getMeasurementValueHistogram_memoise(
    CDMdbHandler,
    conceptIds = paste0(conceptId, "SD")
  )
}
hasMeasurementValues <- !is.null(measurementHistogram) && nrow(measurementHistogram) > 0
```

```{r, eval=hasMeasurementValues, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("## Measured Values\n")
```

```{r, eval=hasMeasurementValues}
createMeasurementHistogramPlot(measurementHistogram)
```
